{{Current events|year=2019|month=02|day=06|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Anchorage earthquake]]
**Two aftershocks strike [[Anchorage, Alaska]], the first a magnitude 4.1, and the second a magnitude 3.7, occurring 23 minutes later. [https://www.adn.com/alaska-news/anchorage/2019/02/06/2-more-aftershocks-strike-anchorage-within-a-half-hour/ (''Anchorage Daily News'')] 
*Heavy rain hits [[Rio de Janeiro|Rio de Janeiro]], leaving three people dead and two missing. [https://g1.globo.com/rj/rio-de-janeiro/noticia/2019/02/06/chuva-volta-ao-rio-na-noite-desta-quarta-e-deve-ficar-ate-domingo.ghtml (''G1'')]
*Fourteen people were killed, and fourteen others are injured when an eight-story apartment building collapsed in [[Istanbul]], [[Turkey]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-47175709 (BBC)]


;Health and environment
*[[2019 Philippines measles outbreak]]
**The Philippines [[Department of Health (Philippines)|Department of Health]] declares a [[measles]] outbreak attributed to the drop in trust in vaccines due to the [[Dengvaxia controversy]]. [https://www.philstar.com/headlines/2019/02/07/1891623/measles-outbreak-declared-metro-manila-central-luzon (''The Philippine Star'')]

;International relations
*[[Accession of Macedonia to NATO]]
**In [[Brussels]], an accession protocol for joining [[NATO]] is signed between [[Jens Stoltenberg]], [[Secretary General of NATO]], and [[Nikola Dimitrov]], foreign minister of the [[Republic of Macedonia]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/amphtml/world/europe/nato-allies-sign-key-macedonia-membership-protocol/2019/02/06/58a1bca8-29fa-11e9-906e-9d55b6451eb4_story.html?noredirect=on (The Washington Post)]
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]], [[Colombia–Venezuela relations]]
**The [[Venezuelan National Guard]] blocks off a bridge on the [[Colombia–Venezuela border]] with a [[Tank truck|tanker truck]]. The Venezuelan opposition had been planning to use the bridge to bring [[humanitarian aid]] into the country, while President [[Nicolás Maduro]] has rejected foreign aid, saying "we're not a nation of beggars". [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-47143492 (BBC)] [http://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/World/2019/Feb-06/475999-us-sends-food-medical-aid-to-venezuela-border.ashx (''Daily Star'')]

;Law and crime
* [[Game law]]
** In a landmark decision, the [[Constitutional Court of Colombia]] rules to ban [[trophy hunting|recreational hunting]], citing [[environmental protection]] concerns. [https://www.eltiempo.com/justicia/investigacion/corte-constitucional-prohibe-a-caza-deportiva-en-colombia-323858# (''El Tiempo'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Guatemalan general election]]
**The [[Attorney General of Guatemala|Attorney General]] filed a request to withdraw immunity to the presidential candidate of [[National Unity of Hope]], former [[First Lady of Guatemala|First Lady]] [[Sandra Torres (politician)|Sandra Torres]], for alleged crimes of illicit electoral financing. Torres said it was a political persecution of the former Attorney General and presidential candidate [[Thelma Aldana]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/the_americas/guatemala-presidential-candidate-targeted-over-financing/2019/02/06/22b5a934-2a62-11e9-906e-9d55b6451eb4_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
